name: Prediction Markets
tagline: Event markets from Polymarket, Kalshi and five more venues
description: Browse event markets in one table: Polymarket and Kalshi together, or Gemini, Limitless, Crypto.com, Polymarket US or Pascal on their own from the Venue menu. Prices, spreads, volume, liquidity, and close dates, filtered by category. Open a market for its order book, recent trades, outcome breakdown, price history, and resolution rules, with live book and trade updates from Polymarket. Also `gloomberb predictions [...]` on the command line for Polymarket and Kalshi, and a chart-series capability so a Polymarket or Kalshi market's price history can be plotted beside anything else.
